nut_cgi.description: Core settings for the NUT CGI web interface (nut_cgi).

host.description: Hostname or IP of the UPS daemon (upsd). Leave blank to use local Unix socket.

cgi_bin.description: Full path to the nut_cgi binary.

user.description: System user account under which the CGI runs (for security).

group.description: System group for the CGI process.

log_level.description: Log verbosity: 0 (silent) to 7 (debug). Higher values increase log detail.

ssl_enabled.description: Whether SSL termination is handled by a front-end proxy (e.g., nginx). nut_cgi itself does not serve HTTPS.

allowed_networks.description: List of IP addresses or CIDR ranges allowed to access the web interface. Empty list means open access (not recommended).

netmask.description: Optional CIDR netmask (e.g., '24', '128'). If omitted, exact match.

ups_list.description: UPS devices to expose via the web interface. At least one is required for meaningful operation.

name.description: UPS identifier (must match a configured UPS in upsmon/upsd).

description.description: Human-readable name displayed in the web UI.

monitor.description: Whether this UPS is actively monitored via upsmon (enables shutdown logic).

password.description: Optional password for read-only or admin access (if authentication is enabled).

acl_group.description: ACL group name for access control (requires upsmon ACL support).
